item.title: Hezbollah, Iran unleash coordinated cluster bomb strikes on Israel in major escalation
item.summary: Hezbollah prepares guerrilla warfare tactics in south Lebanon as Israel launches airstrikes against Beirut strongholds, with expert predicting Israeli ground invasion.

item.title: Lethal elite 'black-clad' kill squad guards Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei
item.summary: Elite NOPO force protects new Iran Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei while deploying around prisons holding political detainees amid reports of prisoner protests.

item.title: More Iranian women's soccer personnel accept asylum in Australia amid threat of punishment in home country
item.summary: Seven Iranian women's soccer players accepted asylum in Australia after Trump urges protection, fearing severe punishment if they are forced to return to Iran.

item.title: San Jose police investigate violent altercation caught on camera as potential antisemitic hate crime
item.summary: San Jose police are investigating a potential antisemitic hate crime following a violent attack at Santana Row. Authorities say the suspects allegedly used antisemitic hate speech.

item.title: Michigan man found guilty of killing wife whose body was discovered in fertilizer tank
item.summary: Michigan man found guilty of wife's murder after her remains were discovered in farm fertilizer tank marked "out of service" in nationally watched case.

item.title: Melissa Joan Hart gets flooded with praise from fans after flaunting body in ocean-side bikini photo
item.summary: Melissa Joan Hart stuns fans in blue bikini Instagram post, calling it her 'new profile pic.' The Sabrina star, 49, receives praise from followers.

item.title: Maggie Gyllenhaal reveals Trump election inspired her to direct films like feminist horror 'The Bride'
item.summary: Maggie Gyllenhaal said Donald Trump's 2016 election inspired her to become a film director, revealing this while promoting her feminist horror film "The Bride!"

item.title: Super Bowl hero Matt Snell dies after lengthy illness, decades-long grudge with Jets
item.summary: Former Jets running back Matt Snell, who rushed for 121 yards in Super Bowl III and set franchise records, has died. His 4,285 yards rank fourth in franchise history.

item.title: Special election replacing Marjorie Taylor Greene goes to runoff between Trump-endorsed candidate and Democrat
item.summary: The candidate Trump endorsed in the race, Lookout Mountain Judicial Circuit District Attorney Clay Fuller, will face Army veteran Shawn Harris in an April runoff election.

item.title: Florida woman allegedly stabs 76-year-old veteran roommate to death, flees in his truck
item.summary: Florida woman allegedly confesses to stabbing 76-year-old veteran roommate, covering body with tarp before stealing his truck in Punta Gorda murder case.
